name: Banh no
summary: Bánh nổ is popped glutinous rice pressed with cane sugar and ginger into a block and sliced, a spring snack. It is pale yellow, crisp, and lightly sweet, and smells of new rice.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls it pale yellow, lightly sweet, crisp, and smelling of new glutinous rice.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: popped roasted glutinous rice mixed with cane sugar, pounded ginger, and hot ginger water, then pressed into a block and sliced. It calls the cake a spring snack and lists it among gifts with bánh thuẫn and bánh in.
priceBand: 30,000 VND for a 250 g bag (Vietnam Airlines).
seoDescription: Bánh nổ, popped glutinous rice pressed with cane sugar and ginger: crisp, lightly sweet, and a spring snack. 30,000 VND for 250 g.
